sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully preserves the required ship-to-load-case-to-component-to-material-properties ownership paths, exclusion applicability, declared operands and result term, units and datatypes, and the required DIRECT_CHECK direction with the safety-factor margin. The COMPLEX_READINESS boundary is respected without inventing full formula reconstruction or additional evidence obligations.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Add an explicit DIRECT_CHECK for every occasional-force case/component pairing that compares occasionalForceComponentStress against componentMaterialYieldStrength with the componentYieldSafetyFactor safety margin in the required direction (stress must not exceed the reduced allowable yield limit). The current shape only requires presence and units, so an invalid stress or safety factor can pass.
